contributions.statement: Prefer context-management schemes that edit only the tail of the prompt, because nearly all of each agent call's prompt repeats the previous call and an early rewrite invalidates the cached prefix.
contributions.evidence: §3: 98.1% of prompt tokens already processed in the prior call; each task submits 1.86M prompt tokens (80x output); argued, not tested against compaction strategies.
relative_to: provider prompt-caching guidance: keep a stable prefix

contributions.statement: Size KV host-memory tiers to the agents' reuse working set before enabling offloading.
contributions.evidence: Fig. 2 / §5.5: 5 -> 20 GiB per rank cut recomputed prefill 93% and makespan 39%; admission policy 35% at 5 GiB.

reason: Sound serving-systems work, but it applies to teams self-hosting inference, not to a backend team using hosted coding agents; the agent-side lesson is known prompt-caching practice.
